title: Review of c43's CIPS consumer on fresh seed 92 and on seed 91 at world dt/2: the pack numbers replicate (consumer persistent splits 23 and 29, prey 72 and 88), but 20/23 and 29/29 consumer splits coincide with a host split and consumers touch a host 91% of the time, so they are not individuals that divide on their own; the default step dt 0.25 blows up on 3 of 12 fresh seeds
summary: Before reading other reviews I looked at the claim's sheet, strips and efork images: consumers are white bands on the edge of blue prey drops, and every division in the strips is the prey drop pinching under a band. Fresh seed 92 (labkit, the claim's settings --frames 120 --lineage-k 5): consumers 29 on average, 23 persistent consumer splits, generation 3, merge/split 0.13; prey 72 persistent splits, generation 8; 0 persistent tracks of either kind (longest 37 frames of 120). Seed 91 crashes at the default world step (non-finite r at step 157), as do seeds 95 and 96 (stability.txt); at the world's own dt 0.125 (WORLD_P, --spf 800) seed 91 runs: consumer 29 persistent splits, generation 4; prey 88, generation 9. c55's pairtest (K=5) on both: consumer splits coincident with a host split 20/23 and 29/29, median share of consumer bodies touching a prey body 0.91, of 7 and 12 consumer tracks living >= 20 frames only 1 and 3 ever meet two unrelated hosts, median share of life alone 0.03-0.04. The consumer is a band that the prey drop carries and splits; I and D for the consumer as an individual are not supported. S holds (a random field gives both kinds by t=500).

observations.S: rerun/seed92/sheet.png t=0 -> t=500: uniform noise to prey drops with consumer bands
observations.I: rerun/pairtest_seed92.json: 0 persistent tracks (longest 37/120 frames), consumers touch a host 91% of frames, alone 4% of life
observations.D: rerun/pairtest_seed92.json and rerun/pairtest_seed91_dthalf.json: 20/23 and 29/29 consumer persistent splits coincide with a prey split

seeds_run.result: pass: pack numbers replicate (consumer persistent splits 23, prey 72); the consumer divides with its host
fail: run crashes at the default world step dt 0.25 (non-finite r at step 157)
pass at world dt 0.125: consumer persistent splits 29, prey 88; consumer divides with its host (29/29)

verdicts.limitation: Triage review: I did not run the consumer-free twin (X) or the prey-removal fork (E). Seeds 91, 95 and 96 blow up within t~40 at the default dt 0.25 and seed 97 overshoots r to 1.13, where (1-r) changes sign (stability.txt); dt 0.125 is stable on those seeds and gives the same counts, so the claim's packs should be run at dt 0.125 or the default changed.
